main.description: Links an entry to a collection. Separate record enables many-to-many relationships (an entry can belong to multiple collections) and decentralized curation (anyone can propose membership).

ordinal.description: Optional ordering position within the collection.

metadata.description: Provenance: who added this entry to this collection, when, with what tool.

features.description: Open-ended features describing this membership: curation confidence, ordering rationale, etc.

createdAt.description: When this membership record was created.
